title: SAVA R21 Gelaro S6/S4 gravel review
notes: Review calls the older R21 S4/S6 frame Toray T700 UD and says trims share a frame, but tested generation/build is not pinned down. Owner reports no noticeable bottom-bracket flex while climbing and stay compliance after 1,800+ km; subjective ride impressions, not a stiffness measurement.
